# fetch

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-reference.js; do not edit by hand. -->

## lookup

```
fetch(options)
```

Looks up existing symbol/market using the given symbol prefix on the Yahoo! network

### Options

| Option | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `interval` |  | lookup |
| `symbol` | Ticker symbol used by the market |  |
| `market` | Exchange market acronym | AEB, ASX, BE, BM, EBS, IBIS, LSE, NASDAQ, COMEX, NYMEX, NYSE, SBF, … |
| `yahoo_symbol` | Symbol for security as used by The Yahoo! Network |  |
| `label` | Identifier used in logging messages |  |

### Properties

`symbol`, `yahoo_symbol`, `market`, `name`, `security_type`, `currency`, `security_tz`, `liquid_hours`, `open_time`, `trading_hours`

## interday

```
fetch(options)
```

Historic data for a security on the Yahoo! network

### Options

| Option | Description | Values |
|---|---|---|
| `interval` | The bar timeframe for the results | day, year, quarter, month, week |
| `symbol` | Ticker symbol used by the market |  |
| `market` | Exchange market acronym | AEB, ASX, BE, BM, EBS, IBIS, LSE, NASDAQ, COMEX, NYMEX, NYSE, SBF, … |
| `yahoo_symbol` | Symbol for security as used by The Yahoo! Network |  |
| `begin` | Sets the earliest date (or dateTime) to retrieve |  |
| `end` | Sets the latest dateTime to retrieve |  |
| `tz` | Timezone used to format the ending field, using the identifier in the tz database |  |
| `ending_format` | Date and time format of the resulting ending field |  |
| `label` | Identifier used in logging messages |  |

### Properties

`ending`, `open`, `high`, `low`, `close`, `volume`, `adj_close`
